heading: What we craft for you

services.title: Custom Curtains & Drapery
services.description: From lightweight sheers to luxurious lined drapes, each piece is tailored to your windows and designed to complement your interior. We work with European fabrics and custom hardware.

services.title: Roman Shades
services.description: Clean, contemporary, and available in a range of fabrics and fold styles. Perfect for modern spaces that need both beauty and precise light control.

services.title: Roller Shades
services.description: Minimalist and practical, with options for light filtering, blackout, and motorization. Ideal for large windows, commercial spaces, and contemporary homes.

bannerImageAlt: White curtain detail showing fine craftsmanship and light quality

steps.title: Consultation
steps.description: We visit your space to understand your needs, take measurements, and discuss style preferences and functional requirements.

steps.title: Design Proposal
steps.description: We present fabric samples, design options, and a detailed proposal with pricing and timeline.

steps.title: Fabrication
steps.description: Your window coverings are crafted with precision and care in our San Juan workshop.

steps.title: Installation
steps.description: Professional installation ensures everything is perfectly fitted and functioning beautifully.

bookingIntro: Fill out the form and we'll be in touch within 48 hours to schedule your in-home consultation. There's no obligation—just a conversation about your space.
